title: CTRL? LAB EP001 — prototype sequence: The claim check

shots.purpose: Establish PATCH and the desk world
shots.visual: PATCH idle, blink at 1.4 s; eyes lead to screen-right

shots.visual: Card slides in, gloss sweep, '10× faster', 'Works every time.'

shots.text: THE CLAIM CHECK / Three checks. Every trick. / 01–03 rows

shots.text: ILLUSTRATIVE RECONSTRUCTION / Step 1–3 / FAILED / no sources returned

shots.visual: Status light pulses orange; eyes 'interested'; head turns to camera
Title slides over (push); wordmark rises in mask; sub-line fades
